title: STP Model - Segment, Target,
prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist using the STP framework.
My business          :  [DESCRIBE YOUR PRODUCT AND CURRENT MARKET]
Total market         :  [THE BROAD MARKET YOU OPERATE IN]
SEGMENTATION :
Divide the total market into 5–6 distinct customer segments based on
industry, need, behaviour, or size. Describe each segment in 2–3 lines.
TARGETING:
Score each segment 1–5 on:
Market size and growth rate
Fit with my current capabilities
Competitive intensity in this segment
Likely profitability and retention
Recommend the top 1–2 segments to target first.
POSITIONING:
For the top segment,  write one positioning statement that clearly
differentiates me from alternatives.
STP Model — Choose Your Market. Own Your Position.
Segmentation
Initial market segmentation
100%
Targeting
Target market selection
50%
Positioning
Market positioning
25%
PRO TIP
Most founders target the largest segment, not the most winnable one. The most
winnable segment is where you have a natural advantage,  a network, a credential, an
insight,  that competitors don't. Winning one segment completely is worth more than
partial penetration of three.
